scope: Retained source, fixtures, and compact evidence only; no provider, credential, canonical-database, queue, or runtime action.

one_minute_opening.envelope: HTTP 200; success must be true; data.items must be a list
one_minute_opening.validation: positive finite full OHLC, minute alignment, bounded half-open window, strictly increasing input order, OHLC invariants

fifteen_minute_historical.envelope: data.items list; success flag is not checked in this helper
fifteen_minute_historical.validation: timestamp positive; low non-negative; full OHLC ordering invariants; rows sorted after validation

lifecycle_probe.envelope: data.items list after explicit HTTP-200 provider-error classification
lifecycle_probe.validation: per-candle positive finite high/low and duplicate valid timestamp rejection; valid rows sorted
lifecycle_probe.failure_mode: partial acceptance, INVALID_CANDLE_VALUES when every row is rejected

field_differences: The lifecycle probe omits unix_time and full open/close fields accepted by both established normalizers.
The lifecycle probe requires positive low whereas the established 15-minute helper permits zero low; neither contract alone proves which value is valid provider MCAP evidence.
The opening-hour normalizer checks success=true, minute alignment, request boundaries and input ordering; the probe does not.
The 15-minute helper sorts validated rows and has no interval-alignment or envelope-success check.

reusable_rules.not_proven: Direct substitution of either legacy all-or-nothing normalizer into the lifecycle probe is not qualified: their success-envelope, zero-value, ordering, boundary, and partial-acceptance contracts differ.

lifecycle_adapter_compatibility: PARTIAL_CONTRACT_MISMATCH; reuse the established aliases and full-OHLC parsing only through a separately provider-free qualified shared contract. No further paid probe is justified by retained evidence.
next_gate: Provider-free shared-normalizer contract qualification against retained known-good 15-minute fixture data, if such a fixture can be located; otherwise no lifecycle acquisition.
